pitch: Safely install, research, plan, connect, configure, and verify MoonPress Chat without exposing credentials to the agent.
problem: A useful chatbot needs grounded business knowledge, approved wording, consent, escalation rules, and a testable launch decision.
Chat-based setup often tempts people to paste WordPress passwords or provider keys into the AI conversation.
This skill separates human authorization from agent work and stores only non-secret, reviewable setup artifacts.

flow.d: Confirm authority, official installation, compatibility, and recovery.
Read public pages and cite the facts.
Reuse site facts and prior answers; ask only unresolved owner decisions.
Temporary credential via the bundled helper; secrets stay out of the transcript.
Review one corrected proposal; approve once, then apply and verify.
Report results briefly and disconnect; public launch needs separate approval.

commands: Set up MoonPress Chat on my WordPress site
Research my site before configuring MoonPress Chat
Help me plan the MoonPress Chat knowledge base
Connect this WordPress site to the MoonPress Chat setup flow
Review whether MoonPress Chat is ready to go live

callout.label: Public alpha
callout.text: Version 0.6.0 is an unreleased candidate with both paths. **The API path is the default** — MoonPress Chat's stable setup API (MoonPress Chat 5.0.0 or newer) plus the bundled macOS credential helper — and the human-guided wp-admin path remains the fallback for multisite, plugins older than 5.0.0, or unsupported credential backends.

limits.label: Safety boundaries
items: No WordPress passwords, Application Passwords, provider keys, or tokens in chat — the helper holds the temporary credential in the macOS Keychain.
No browser automation, SSH, XML-RPC, direct database writes, or internal admin routes; API calls stay inside moonpresschat/v1/setup.
No arbitrary plugin package, no production change without backup and explicit approval, and go-live is a separate approval that revokes the connection.
